{{Current events|year=2019|month=02|day=09|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Piper PA-46 Malibu crash]]
**The family of pilot David Ibbotson launch a [[GoFundMe]] campaign to locate and recover his body, raising thousands of [[pound sterling|pounds]] within hours. Footballer [[Emiliano Sala]]'s body was recently found in the wreckage and recovered two weeks after the plane first went missing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-lincolnshire-47184123 (BBC)]
*[[2018–19 North American winter]]
**Cities in the [[Seattle metropolitan area]] receive {{convert|10|in|cm}} of snow, the most in 70 years. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/winter-storm-maya-seattle-snowfall-most-snow-in-70-years-bitter-cold-temperatures-expected-2019-02-09/ (CBS News)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Elizabeth Warren 2020 presidential campaign]]
***United States Senator [[Elizabeth Warren]] announces her intention to run for President of the United States in the 2020 United States presidential election. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/02/09/politics/elizabeth-warren-campaign-kickoff-massachusetts/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**Venezuela's interim [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Juan Guaidó]] says he will not rule out seeking the help of the [[United States Armed Forces|United States military]] to remove [[Nicolás Maduro]] from power. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190209-venezuela-guaido-not-rule-out-authorising-us-intervention (AFP via France 24)]
**Venezuelan authorities claim that a U.S.-owned air freight company delivered a crate of weapons to the international airport in [[Valencia, Carabobo|Valencia]] to be used in "terrorist actions" against the Maduro government. The air charter business involved, 21 Air, denies the charges. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/sns-tns-bc-venezuela-weapons-20190209-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]
;Sports
*[[2019 AAF season]] 
**The [[Alliance of American Football]] kicks off its first season with two games. [https://www.cbssports.com/aaf/news/aaf-week-1-scores-highlights-orlando-san-antonio-win-openers-spurrier-calls-philly-special-for-td/ (CBS Sports)]
